_comment: SIMULATED rate cards. Values are illustrative and calibrated to public remittance-cost literature; they are NOT live provider quotes (PRD §4.3, CLAUDE.md §9).

rails.label: Bank transfer
rails.assumptions: Fee and spread illustrative, calibrated to the World Bank Remittance Prices Worldwide band for bank wires.
rails.limitations: Not a live quote; introduced for simulation only.

rails.label: Mobile wallet
rails.assumptions: Lower fixed fee, slightly worse spread, faster settlement; illustrative.
rails.limitations: Not a live quote; introduced for simulation only.

rails.label: Card network
rails.limitations: Not a live quote; introduced for simulation only.

rails.label: Standard bank wire (default baseline)
rails.assumptions: Transparent 'standard bank wire' baseline used only to compute savings; a stated fee, not an arbitrary expensive route.
rails.limitations: Not a live quote; introduced for simulation only.
